title: Autumn colors cotton quilt set
text: Autumn colors cotton quilt set. I only purchase cotton quilts because you can machine wash and dry them - and this was no exception.  Did great in the washer and dryer (low).  Colors are very Autumn tones, bright and colorful.  The hand is .. sturdy.  Not rough, but a solidly cotton.  I really like it.  I purchased the Queen size, comes with quilt and 2 standard size shams.  Fits perfectly on the bed with about a 18" fall on sides, top enough to cover sleeping pillows.  The edges are scalloped and brown piping all along.  In my opinion, a good price for the value.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
